data.name: The Archive
overview: The Archive at Dubailand Residence Complex (DLRC) is a 17-floor residential development offering **studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments**. Designed with comfort and functionality in mind, the project combines modern architecture with thoughtfully planned living spaces, making it well positioned for strong capital appreciation in one of Dubai’s rapidly growing communities.

The Archive by Imtiaz Developments brings together lifestyle-focused amenities that encourage relaxation, recreation, and everyday convenience. Residents can enjoy a shallow water feature lounge, floating cabanas, outdoor relaxation lounges, mini golf, a signature library, and a dedicated kids’ play area, creating a welcoming environment for individuals and families alike.
